strategy.thesis: Self-described as the longest-running technology incubator. Identifies big problems with technology solutions, tests many ideas in parallel under one roof, and spins promising prototypes into standalone companies with seed capital and a recruited team.

application.how_to_apply: Idealab builds companies internally; it is not a cohort-based open application program.

summary.en: Pasadena, CA technology incubator and startup studio founded by Bill Gross in 1996, widely cited as the original / longest-running startup studio. Has created over 150 companies with more than 45 IPOs and acquisitions, including Overture (sold to Yahoo! for ~$1.63B), Picasa (Google) and Heliogen.

summary.en: Sunnyvale, CA innovation platform / incubator-accelerator founded by Saeed Amidi in 2006. Runs 50+ vertical, corporate-sponsored accelerator programs across 35+ global locations and invests via its venture arm. Cited by CB Insights as the most active startup accelerator in the world (avg ~929 deals/yr, 2020–2022). Early tenant investments include Google, PayPal, Dropbox and LendingClub.

summary.en: Chicago nonprofit incubator for physical product development and HardTech, opened in 2017 by Haven Allen and Bill Fienup. Offers 11 prototyping labs plus a venture-backed accelerator (mHUB Ventures) that invests $200,000 ($142,500 cash + $60,000 in-kind) for 6.5% equity over a six-month program. Has supported 500+ startups generating ~$4.5B in economic activity.
